hypothesis: Y027 showed steadily weaker cache gains as stationary geometric drift increased. With preregistered alternating slow/fast drift but identical memory capacity, determine whether legal observed-state reuse and churn reduction survive intermittent shifts.
freeze: Freeze entire 8-episode displacement schedule, seeds, matching and storage policies, metrics and outcome criteria before first execution; no adjustment after result.
population: Same inherited seven active and up-to-nine retained, 16 total keys/cells, four-key collision, radius-two circular graph, eight episodes per seed.
displacement_schedule: episode positions are cumulative shifts from increments [1,5,1,5,1,5,1], giving positions [0,1,6,7,12,13,18,19] mod16. No future shifts passed to either policy.
arms: same nine-slot cache-write sham that never reads prior assignment
same cache-write protocol with prior assignment read only if legal under current episode geometry
metric: Heldout cumulative returning-key assignment churn, per-episode churn, per-episode legal preference reuse, search calls and write counts; full per-seed outcomes.
classification: ALTERNATING_DRIFT_BENEFIT if heldout total churn saved>0 and all match cardinalities valid; HARM if saved<0; NEUTRAL if zero. No hidden threshold or selecting episodes after observation.
validation: Exact predecessor and frozen source, separate exhaustive Hall cardinality for 7 active nodes, equal cache capacity and write counts, deterministic repeat, original artifact, one full repo regression.
claim_limit: Synthetic nonstationary assignment retention only; no learned policy, real developmental cognition, or acceptance authority.
